Changing `projectAccess` (`backend/src/middleware/project-access.ts:16`) affects 4 route files and 18 route call sites. I did not modify any file.

**Callers (route files)**
- `backend/src/routes/projects.routes.ts:29,34,40,43,48,54`: 6 sites. Lines 34, 40, 48 and 54 are OWNER-only with `write: true`. Lines 29 and 43 are read-only for any member.
- `backend/src/routes/tasks.routes.ts:32,39,46,53,60,67,74`: 7 sites. Five use `write: true` (32, 53, 60, 67, 74) and two are read (39, 46).
- `backend/src/routes/comments.routes.ts:30,37,44,51`: 4 sites. Three use `write: true` (30, 44, 51) and one is read (37).
- `backend/src/routes/activity.routes.ts:23`: 1 read site.

**Downstream readers of what it sets**
- `backend/src/middleware/project-access.ts:43-44` sets `res.locals.project` and `res.locals.membership`.
- `backend/src/controllers/comments.controller.ts:35` reads `membership.role`.
- `backend/src/controllers/projects.controller.ts:30` reads `membership.role`.
- A change to the shape of `res.locals.membership` breaks both controllers.

**Behaviours the code and spec depend on**
- The check order is 404, then 403, then 409 (`project-access.ts:31,35,39`).
- It is specified in `openspec/specs/projects/spec.md:112`. Changing it needs an OpenSpec change under the repo workflow.
- `projects.service.ts:69` and `:87` have comments assuming the middleware already checked membership and the archived state.

**Tests to re-run**
- `backend/src/middleware/project-access.integration.test.ts:36,45,54` covers the middleware directly on a throwaway route. The graph's `tests_for` found only this file.
- The remaining tests exercise the middleware through the routes. I matched them by file name and did not open them:
  - Projects: `projects.integration.test.ts`, `projects.archive.integration.test.ts`, `projects.members.integration.test.ts`
  - Tasks: `tasks.create-get.integration.test.ts`, `tasks.update.integration.test.ts`, `tasks.assign-status.integration.test.ts`, `tasks.archive.integration.test.ts`, `tasks.list.integration.test.ts`, `tasks.filter-paginate.integration.test.ts`, `tasks.sort.integration.test.ts`, `tasks.activity.integration.test.ts`
  - Comments and activity: `comments.add-list.integration.test.ts`, `comments.edit-delete.integration.test.ts`, `activity.history.integration.test.ts`
- Not affected: the auth tests, `app.test.ts`, `config.test.ts`, `index.test.ts` and `server.test.ts`. `comments-activity.schema.integration.test.ts` is probably a schema test and likely unaffected. I did not verify these.
- In practice, run `pnpm test` for the backend package.

**Caveat on the graph:** it was built at `71307ad` and HEAD is `8f1f539`. The commits since then are docs-only, so the results should still hold. The graph does not link route-level tests to `projectAccess`, which is why the route-based test list above comes from file names.
